column1: # TrustIr binary wire-version reservation ledger (roadmap WS8.5, DG-14).
# One row per version number, contiguous and ascending. Columns are TAB
# separated:
#   version  status  feature  reserving-commit  owner-increment
# status:
#   retired   below MIN_READ_VERSION (the v24 read-floor move); never read.
#   shipped   read by this build; VERSION is the highest shipped row.
#   refused   inside the reader's range but refused on read (v26..=v28,
#             ambiguous lineage). The refused rows must be exactly
#             binary.rs `AMBIGUOUS_LINEAGE_VERSIONS`, the range the reader
#             refuses and `BUILD_IDENTITY` reports.
#   reserved  claimed for a feature group that has not shipped; strictly
#             above VERSION, so no reader accepts it yet.
# A version needs a row before any read gate (`version >= N`), writer
# selection or golden spells it; add it in the same commit as that code, one
# number per feature group (groups ready together may share one). Shipping
# flips the row to `shipped` in the commit that raises VERSION.
# reserving-commit: `pre-ledger` for rows at or below v43 (they predate this
# file and were never reserved), otherwise `self` (the commit that adds the
# row; `git log -S` on this file recovers it) or an abbreviated commit hash.
# owner-increment: `-` for pre-ledger rows, otherwise the roadmap increment
# or lane that owns the group (for example WS1.12), or that lane pinned to the
# commit that landed its claim on main, `<lane>@<commit>` (wire-allocations.toml).
# feature: must NAME, as a whole identifier, every `*_FORMAT_VERSION` constant
# in binary.rs whose value is that version; every shipped row above
# BASE_FORMAT_VERSION must be carried by at least one such (writer-selection)
# constant. A literal comparison against a version in binary.rs code
# (`r.version >= N`) may only spell a number that already has a row here. The
# `wire_version_ledger` unit test in crates/trust-ir/src/binary.rs enforces
# every rule above (CI gate wire-version-ledger).
# This file is bound to the `wire_version` table of `wire-allocations.toml`
# (repo root): gate 0 and gate 10 refuse any number the two tell differently.
#     python3 scripts/wire_alloc.py reserve version --feature <f> --constant <C> --owner <increment>
# writes BOTH files; a row added here by hand is copied across by
#     python3 scripts/wire_alloc.py sync
